description: Upload a picture (JPEG or PNG) or a video (MP4 or MOV) from a public https link to the ad account, up to 32 MB. For the hosted version, which cannot read files from your computer. It is not attached to any ad. Then poll snap_get_media until READY and use its id in a creative. Two steps: confirm=false returns a preview and an approval_token; to apply, repeat the same arguments with confirm=true and that approval_token.

approval_token.description: The approval_token returned by the preview of this exact request. Required with confirm=true.

confirm.description: false = preview only (nothing sent). true = apply; needs approval_token from the preview.

name.description: Name to give the new item. Shown in Ads Manager.

url.description: A public https link straight to the file

name: snap_upload_media_from_url
